note: 替换12道'成分识别'术语题(句子中X作什么成分→中文术语)的12道新应用题。搭配避开已用的(addicted to/responsible for/fluent/interested in/good at/afraid of/keen on/proud of/good for/ready to),改用 curious about/tired of/popular with/worried about + 多样名词/副词短语。NP5/AdjP4/AdvP3,读句判断短语类型,4选项不同类型只一个对,不超纲,答案唯一,带解析。

r1u1.01.explanation: building 后接宾语需名词短语 a new library;very modern/open to all 形容词短语、quite fast 副词短语,不能作宾语。

r1u1.01.stem: "____ took part in the charity show."
r1u1.01.explanation: 句子缺主语,需名词短语 Many young volunteers;其余是副词/形容词短语,不能作主语。
bring us 后接直接宾语需名词短语 a healthy life;其余是副词/形容词短语。

r1u1.01.stem: "The students raised ____ for the poor children."
r1u1.01.explanation: raised 后接宾语需名词短语 a lot of money;very kindly 副词短语、quite generous/willing to help 形容词短语。

r1u1.01.stem: "I will never forget ____ in junior high."
r1u1.01.explanation: forget 后接宾语需名词短语 my best friends;其余是副词/形容词短语。

r1u1.02.stem: "Young children are often ____ the world around them."
r1u1.02.explanation: be curious about 对…好奇,形容词短语作表语;a big question 名词短语、ask a lot 动词短语、very often 副词短语,均不合适。

r1u1.02.stem: "After the long trip, we were all ____ walking."
r1u1.02.explanation: be tired of 厌倦,形容词短语作表语:be tired of walking;其余不能跟在 were 后接 walking。
be popular with 受…欢迎,形容词短语作表语:popular with young people;a big hit 名词短语、sing along 动词短语、quite loudly 副词短语。
feel 是系动词,后接形容词短语 worried about 作表语:worried about their results;其余是名词/动词/副词短语。

r1u1.03.explanation: 修饰 is getting better 表方式/程度需副词短语 day by day;a big step 名词短语、very good 形容词短语、speak more 动词短语。

r1u1.03.stem: "The crowd cheered ____ when the team won."
r1u1.03.explanation: 修饰动词 cheered 需副词短语 loudly and happily;a great victory 名词短语、very excited 形容词短语、jump up 动词短语。
修饰动词 explained 需副词短语 very clearly;a clear example 名词短语、very clear 形容词短语、explain again 动词短语。
